cues.sub: Tower, this is Deck One. Eight cards on board. One player on the controls. Pray for us.
Listen up! Eight of us. Four at the door. Four on the bench.
Door cards can be played. Bench cards wait. The Thumb drags a door card onto the field, that card jumps, and the next one on the bench steps up.
Jump, fight, back in the queue. The circle of life.
Every jump costs Copium. Cupsey, four. LMAO, four. Chillhouse, five.
And if he doesn't have enough?
And if he has too much? Copium stops at ten. Everything above that is wasted.
Match on! Eyes on the screen! Wait for the Thumb!
Chillhouse! Five Copium! He can afford you!
He's dragging onto the enemy side!
Can't deploy past the river. Not until one of their towers falls.
Units keep fighting after they jump. Remember?
Second tower down! Two towers to none!
Copium overdose! Everything fills twice as fast!
Airdrop! Their whole push is on the other side. He dropped it on our side.
Don't stack a push. Three cards, then defend.
Finally. I soak hits. I can't be stunned or knocked back. I'm basically furniture.
Meme Royale. Free to play. Drag with purpose.
